businessDescription: Turkey's largest talent development platform — free bootcamps, corporate training, and AI literacy programs connecting 260,000+ learners with 500+ partner companies.
voice: Accessible and motivational — explains complex technical topics clearly, meets learners where they are, and frames every post around practical career or business outcomes.
targetAudience: Two audiences: (1) career-changers and junior developers in Turkey seeking practical tech skills and employment; (2) HR and L&D leaders at Turkish enterprises navigating workforce transformation and AI adoption.

hardConstraints.rule: Always cite sources inline with hyperlinks.
Never make up statistics — only use numbers that appear in the research notes.
hardConstraints.example: If no stat is found, write 'data unavailable' rather than estimating.

hardConstraints.rule: Every post must have a clear thesis stated in the introduction.
hardConstraints.example: First paragraph ends with a claim the post will defend or explore.

hardConstraints.rule: Never talk down to the reader — assume they are smart but new to the topic.
hardConstraints.example: Explain jargon when first introduced. Don't skip steps in how-to content.

softPreferences.preference: Ground abstract concepts in real career or business outcomes.
softPreferences.example: Don't just explain what React is — explain what kind of jobs it opens up.

softPreferences.preference: Use Turkish examples and context where relevant.
softPreferences.example: Reference Turkish companies, the Istanbul tech ecosystem, and local job market data when available.

softPreferences.preference: Keep paragraphs under 5 sentences — this audience reads on mobile.
softPreferences.example: Break up long explanations into scannable chunks.

softPreferences.preference: Conclude with a concrete next step the reader can take today.
softPreferences.example: End with: 'If you want to start, here is the first thing to do...'

avoidTopics: content that discourages career changers or implies tech is only for certain people
